```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(GenomicRanges)
```

```{r}
# Create protein-coding gene IDs (the GTF can't tell them apart from TE genes, the original GFF can)
gff <- readLines("/groups/nordborg/projects/ddm1_resilencing/11_resources/ref_genome/TAIR10_GFF3_genes_transposons.gff")
pcg_ids <- sub(".*ID=([^;]+).*", "\\1", grep("\tgene\t.*protein_coding_gene", gff, value = TRUE))
# Read gtf
gtf <- read.delim("/groups/nordborg/projects/ddm1_resilencing/11_resources/ref_genome/TAIR10_TE_genes_synthetic_with_OP_direction.gtf", header = FALSE, comment.char = "#", quote = "")
gtf <- gtf[gtf$V3 == "transcript", ]
gtf$gene_id <- sub('.*gene_id "([^"]+)".*', "\\1", gtf$V9)
```

```{r}
# Subset protein-coding genes and TEs (sense + _OP)
genes <- gtf[gtf$gene_id %in% pcg_ids, ]
tes   <- gtf[grepl("^AT[1-5]TE", gtf$gene_id), ]

te_gr   <- GRanges(tes$V1,   IRanges(tes$V4,   tes$V5),   strand = tes$V7)
gene_gr <- GRanges(genes$V1, IRanges(genes$V4, genes$V5), strand = genes$V7)
TE_overlap <- unique(tes$gene_id[overlapsAny(te_gr, gene_gr)])

# Save
cat("protein-coding genes:", length(unique(genes$gene_id)),
    "| TE features:", length(unique(tes$gene_id)),
    "| TEs overlapping a gene:", length(TE_overlap), "\n")
writeLines(TE_overlap, "/groups/nordborg/projects/ddm1_resilencing/11_resources/ref_genome/TE_overlap_PCG.txt")
writeLines(unique(genes$gene_id), "/groups/nordborg/projects/ddm1_resilencing/11_resources/ref_genome/PCG_ids.txt")
```

```{r}
## Visualize 3' bias 
library(GenomicAlignments)
bam   <- "/scratch-cbe/users/elizaveta.grigoreva/ddm1_resilencing/processing/snakemake_run/aligned/299409_S5_1/Aligned.sortedByCoord.out.bam"

end3     <- ifelse(genes$V7 == "+", genes$V5, genes$V4)        # 3' end, strand-aware
gene_end <- GRanges(genes$V1, IRanges(end3, end3), strand = genes$V7)

i  <- nearest(read_end, gene_end)                              # same strand only
ok <- !is.na(i)
d  <- start(read_end[ok]) - start(gene_end[i[ok]])
d  <- ifelse(as.character(strand(read_end[ok])) == "+", d, -d) # + = past the gene end
keep_d <- abs(d) <= 2000
s  <- as.character(strand(read_end[ok]))[keep_d]
d  <- d[keep_d]

par(mfrow = c(1, 2))
hist(d[s == "+"], breaks = 200, main = "+ strand genes", xlab = "bp from 3' end")
hist(d[s == "-"], breaks = 200, main = "- strand genes", xlab = "bp from 3' end")

hist(d, breaks = 200, main = "Read ends relative to gene 3' end", xlab = "bp (negative = inside gene)")
```
